name: Vácduka (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Vácduka (a quartered red and blue shield with a spade, ears of grain, a fleur-de-lis and a patriarchal cross) above a yellow scroll inscribed VÁCDUKA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
